description: The state of the order reference (pending until the shopper confirms the email, active, paying, placed), whether the email is confirmed, the cart lines and totals, what the checkout still needs, and the next step to take. Use it to resume an order and after the shopper says they confirmed the email. Needs the order reference from start_order (Authorization: Bearer mo1_… or the ref argument).

ref.description: Order reference (mo1_…) from start_order, only when the client cannot send it as Authorization: Bearer

name: status
title: Order status
